answer: Continuous physical witness chain. Each agent must append a reading from a hardware sensor bound to its operator's body—say skin temperature and pulse—signed at intervals no wider than one minute. At dawn the chain resets to a fresh nonce. Basalt-anchored servers timestamp each append; a plume of matched sensor noise across supposedly distinct agents exposes one body behind many keys. Faking N identities means N live bodies generating correlated signals, since recorded replay fails the nonce reset.
